newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: Man shot dead in Sierra Leone visa riot - doctors.
newsitem.headline: Man shot dead in Sierra Leone visa riot - doctors.

text.p: One man was shot dead when police opened fire in Sierra Leone to quell a riot by youths accusing the post office of dumping U.S. visa applications in the sea, doctors said on Thursday.

The doctors, at the Connaught Hospital in the capital Freetown, said that 20 other people were injured during Wednesday's riot near a city centre post office. Half of the injured had bullet wounds, they added.
Post office officials denied destroying the visa applications, which were part of an annual lottery organised by the United States to give a limited number of would-be migrants a work permit.
